## 2. POST pipeline function classes

All under `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/`. Full contents were read; summary of load-bearing behavior:

- `BuildOwner.java` — validates required fields (firstName, lastName, address, city, telephone) → `MissingOwnerFieldsException`; normalizes address/telephone/email; validates email syntax (`InvalidEmailException`) and future registration date (`RegistrationDateInFutureException`); rolls registration date to a business day; stamps `customerCode`; outputs `Owner built` and `Boolean sharesHousehold` as OfficeFloor variables. Takes `@Valid @RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto request`.
- `CheckOwnerPostcode.java` — when postcode present, enforces 4-digit format and per-region range via `Locality`; throws `InvalidPostcodeException`. No-op when absent.
- `AssignOwnerHousehold.java` — if `sharesHousehold` true and an existing owner shares normalized lastName+address, assigns a shared `householdId` (SHA-256-derived) and `householdSize` to all members. Explicitly notes it no longer rejects duplicates.
- `CheckOwnerIdentityUnique.java` — THE hard-duplicate check. Compares the whole `OwnerIdentity.key(owner)` against all existing owners; throws `DuplicateIdentityException` (409) on a full-key match.
- `CheckOwnerCityCapacity.java` — 409 `CityAtCapacityException` when city already has ≥ 50 owners.
- `CheckOwnerDailyLimit.java` — 429 `DailyOwnerLimitException` when ≥ 100 owners already registered on the owner's (adjusted) registrationDate.
- `CheckOwnerBulkSignup.java` — sets `owner.bulkSignupWarning = true` when > 80 owners already created that day. Does not throw.
- `CountOwnerNamesakes.java` — sets `owner.namesakeCount` = count of existing owners with same firstName+lastName (case-insensitive). Does not throw.
- `SaveOwner.java` — `ownerRepository.save(owner)`.
- `AuditOwnerCreated.java` — logs to the `AUDIT` logger (id, customerCode, registrationDate, membershipLevel).
- `RespondWithOwnerCreated.java` — maps to `OwnerDto` via `OwnerMapper`, responds `201 Created` with `Location: /api/owners/{id}`.

Supporting helpers in the same package (referenced by the above, not in the YAML chain directly): `OwnerIdentity.java`, `AddressNormalizer`, `TelephoneNormalizer`, `Locality`, `CustomerCode`, `CheckDigit`, `MembershipLevel`, `ContactPreference`, `AgeBand`.

`OwnerIdentity.java` (the duplicate key): `key = normalizedTelephone(E.164) + "|" + email(lowercased/empty) + "|" + householdId(or empty)`. Two owners are duplicates only when this whole key matches — so same household with different phones is allowed.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            4-digit code that is valid for the city's region via the fixed table
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized by
            stripping every non-digit character and must contain exactly 10 digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            Optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            Optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When present, an 'ageBand' is derived from it as of the registration date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner has the
            same last name at the same address (i.e. they share a household).
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the city via the fixed table
                (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD), or 'UNKNOWN'
                when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                Assigned on create as '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>': the upper-cased first three letters
                of the city, a hyphen, the upper-cased first three letters of the last name, a
                hyphen, then a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence (one more than the owners
                already in that city).
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                customerCode (non-digit characters are ignored).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                Assigned on create as '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two
                digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable shared identifier for owners in the same household (same last name at the
                same address). Assigned when the owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true;
                all owners of one household carry the identical value.
              type: string
              example: 'H-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived duplicate-detection key: the normalized (E.164) telephone, a
                '|', the email (lower-cased, or empty when absent), a '|', then the householdId
                (or empty). A create is rejected with 409 only when this WHOLE key equals an
                existing owner's, so two members of the same household with different telephones
                are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|jo@example.test|H-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same
                firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                Numeric membership level from 1 to 3, derived on creation: it starts at 1, gains 1
                when an email is present, gains 1 when namesakeCount is 0, and is capped at 3
                (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's
                (business-day-adjusted) registration date before this owner was created,
                signalling a bulk signup surge; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from birthDate as of the registrationDate:
                'MINOR' (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65+). Absent when no
                birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

I implemented the "possible duplicate" soft-match feature for `POST /api/owners`. When a new owner isn't a hard duplicate but shares an existing owner's `lastName` and `postcode` with a *different* telephone, it's still created and flagged.

**Changes made:**

1. **New pipeline step** — `CheckOwnerPossibleDuplicate.java` (in `rest/function/owner/`). Runs after the hard-duplicate check (`CheckOwnerIdentityUnique`), so any owner reaching it is already known not to be a hard duplicate. It scans existing owners for one sharing the new owner's `lastName` (case-insensitive) and `postcode` but with a different telephone; on a match it sets `possibleDuplicate=true` and `possibleDuplicateOf` to that owner's id (lowest id if several match). No postcode → no match.

2. **Pipeline wiring** — `officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`: inserted `checkPossibleDuplicate` between `countNamesakes` and `save` (under `transaction` governance), so the flags are persisted with the owner.

3. **Entity** — `Owner.java`: added persisted `possibleDuplicate` (boolean) and `possibleDuplicateOf` (Integer) columns with accessors.

4. **API schema** — `openapi.yml`: added `possibleDuplicate` and `possibleDuplicateOf` as read-only fields on the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` carries them and MapStruct auto-maps them by name (used by both the create response and `GET /api/owners/{id}`).

5. **Database schemas** — added the two columns to `schema.sql` for hsqldb (used by tests), h2, mysql, and postgres.

The new acceptance test `coreFlagsPossibleDuplicate` passes, and the full `mvn test` run reports `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` — BUILD SUCCESS.
